event: 2025 ILCA 4 YOUTH EUROPEAN CHAMPIONSHIPS & OPEN EUROPEAN TROPHY
procedural_matters: IRL 216891 did not ask to withdraw the protest after the arbitration meeting and neither boat took a Post-Race Penalty under RRS T1(a).
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
Coach from Ireland, Liam Glynn, attended the hearing as an observer.
Coach from Spain, Pol Font Reyero, attended the hearing as an observer.
facts: IRL 216891 was not able to prove that ESP 221420 was the correct respondent.
conclusions: The protest did not identify the protestee as required by RRS 60.3(a).
By not identifying the protestee, IRL 216891 failed to comply with RRS 60.3(a), as required by RRS 60.4(a)(1).
decision: The protest is invalid. The hearing is closed under RRS 63.4(a)(1).
